newsitem.title: FRANCE: Marseille August air cargo gains 10.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Marseille August air cargo gains 10.1 pct.

text.p: Marseille-Provence airport said it handled 3,413 tonnes of air cargo traffic last month, an increase of 10.1 percent on August 1995.

The two principal factors in traffic growth during the month in question, was strong growth in the volume of traffic handled by Air Afrique and French airline, L'Aeropostale, an airport authority official told Reuters.
In the first eight months of 1996, throughput at France's second biggest gateway for airfreight (after the Paris airports) totalled 28,913 tonnes, down 0.9 percent on the same period last year.

"We are gradually recovering the traffic we lost in the early months of the year and expect 1996 as a whole to show an increase in airfreight throughput of around 1.5 percent on 1995 levels," the official said.

January-August 1996 postal traffic handled at Marseille totalled 13,381 tonnes, an increase of 9.1 percent on 1995 levels, the official added. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 8982 Fax +44 171 542 5017
